'''''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion''''' is a [[canon]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] miniseries in [[Marvel Comics]]' [[Age of Star Wars|Age of ''Star Wars'']] maxi-series, which spans three eras of ''[[Star Wars]]'' storytelling. The series was written by [[Greg Pak]] and focuses on iconic heroes and villains in the [[original trilogy]] era.
